beats.label: Do Now — one document, five years
beats.line: 1865 to 1870. Three amendments. Put a word next to each year before I say anything.

beats.label: Context — what the war did not settle
beats.line: The war ended slavery. It did not say what came after. That gap is the whole unit.

beats.label: Model — read the three
beats.line: 13th out loud together. 14th, you read it with a partner. 15th, on your own.

board.head: THE THREE
lines: 15th — the vote, race is not a bar

beats.label: The argument — did it work?
beats.line: Somebody will bring up 1965. Let them get there before you do.
beats.note: student-led discourse — a rubric look-for, if anyone were watching

beats.label: Exit ticket
beats.line: One sentence. Which amendment still gets argued about in court, and why.

filler.label: Sustained silent work
filler.line: You are out of lesson and not out of period. This is the oldest move there is.

rushed.title: You moved on
rushed.body: Half of them were still writing. You saw it and you moved on anyway.

belabor.title: Still on this
belabor.body: You have been on {label} for a while. Two kids have stopped writing and started waiting.

outOfBeats.title: That's the lesson
outOfBeats.body: There are eleven minutes left and nothing planned in them.

check.title: Check for understanding
check.body: Thumbs, whiteboards, whatever you use. Now you know instead of assuming.

checkAgain.title: Checking again
checkAgain.body: You just checked. They can tell you are stalling.

checkCold.title: Nothing to check
checkCold.body: You have not said anything yet to check on.

reteach.title: You back up
reteach.body: "Let me say that a different way." It costs you four minutes you did not have.

reteachBlind.title: Reteaching blind
reteachBlind.body: You back up without checking first, so you reteach the part they already had.

greenIsland.title: Comprehension
greenIsland.body: {name} has it. {name} has had it for ten minutes and has not said a word.
